subject: Discovery recap + align on evaluation kickoff and technical deep dive
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Samira Kahn <samira.k@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + align on evaluation kickoff and technical deep dive

Hi Samira — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we can lock the evaluation kickoff and technical deep dive: 

Summary of discovery (high level)
- Primary goal: prototype assisted chart summarization and diagnosis suggestions for ED workflows; target reduction in triage time by 20% and false-negative miss-rate below 2% on our sample set.
- Data: mix of de-identified EHR notes + structured vitals; will need clarification on retention policy and allowed PII levels during the trial.
- Success criteria (draft): throughput target (p95 latency < 300ms for single-record inference), qualitative pass on 3 clinician prompt scenarios, and no data egress to third-party models.

Proposed next steps
1) Schedule a 60–75 minute evaluation kickoff that covers: trial scope, success criteria, prompt pack review, security requirements, and logistics (procurement/KMS).
2) Follow with a 60-minute technical deep dive (solutions engineer) to validate integration points, sample data flow, and test harness.
3) Deliver a mutual action plan and a starter prompt pack for Novamed to pre-populate before the kickoff.

Attached: mutual-action-plan-draft.pdf, prompt-pack-template.xlsx (starter prompts and eval matrix).

Open slots (Pacific time):
- Tue May 4: 10:00–11:15 AM or 2:00–3:15 PM PT
- Wed May 5: 9:00–10:15 AM PT or 4:00–5:15 PM PT
- Thu May 6: 11:30 AM–12:45 PM PT

If those don't work, share a couple of windows and I will coordinate with Karthik and Monica. I copied Monica (CS lead) to start prepping the success criteria document and Karthik (solutions) for the deep dive.

Thanks — Jasmine
--
Jasmine Liu | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Samira Kahn <samira.k@novamed.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Romanov <elena.proc@novamed.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + align on evaluation kickoff and technical deep dive

Thanks Jasmine, great recap — this aligns with my notes. A few points from our side: 

- Confirmed success criteria: clinician accuracy on the three scenarios is our highest priority; latency target is important but we'll accept a slightly higher p95 during the initial stage as long as throughput and stability are reasonable.
- Data: we will provide de-identified CSV exports for the pilot. I need to confirm with our privacy officer how much structured metadata can be included; will update by Tuesday.
- Procurement: looped in Elena (cc). She's our contracts lead and will handle NDA/PO steps. We do need a SOC 2 overview and a short matrix of security controls for our InfoSec team.

For scheduling, Wed May 5 at 9:00 AM PT works for the kickoff. For the technical deep dive, we prefer Thu May 6 late morning (11:00–12:15 PT) if that slot can be confirmed with Karthik. 

I'll attach a small sample set (de-identified) after I get privacy sign-off — earliest is Monday.

Samira
Director of Clinical Innovation
Novamed Health

Subject: Re: Discovery recap + align on evaluation kickoff and technical deep dive

Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround. Wed May 5 at 9:00 AM PT is tentatively reserved on our side for the evaluation kickoff (60–75 min). Thu May 6 11:00–12:15 PT for the technical deep dive is also tentatively OK; Karthik, can you confirm?

Elena — welcome — we typically send a short SOC2 + security controls summary and a one-page data handling addendum ahead of the kickoff. Would you like those sent to your team as a single PDF or split documents? We can also enable a view-only drive folder with the compliance pack.

Action items I will own before kickoff:
- Finalize mutual-action-plan and circulate updated version (jasmine).
- Share a starter prompt pack + eval matrix (jasmine).
- Pre-send SOC2 summary + data handling matrix (either jasmine or security ops) once you confirm preferred format.

Karthik / Monica, assume you're OK to be on the kickoff and tech deep dive — any additional asks?

Thanks — will wait for confirmations and any slot conflicts.

Best,
Jasmine
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samira Kahn <samira.k@novamed.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 13:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + align on evaluation kickoff and technical deep dive

Thanks team — I can cover Thu May 6 11:00–12:15 PT for the technical deep dive. A couple of asks to make the session productive: 

Proposed technical deep dive agenda (60–75 min)
- 5m: Introductions + goals for the session
- 15m: Novamed architecture overview (Samira) — where inference will be invoked and data flow expectations
- 20m: Redwood integration options (API vs private connector), auth/KMS patterns, network topologies
- 10m: Prompt engineering examples and expected sample data format (we'll review the prompt pack)
- 10m: Test harness and evaluation harness (how we'll run the clinician scenarios and capture metrics)
- 10m: Next steps / action items / timeline for trial provisioning

Requests prior to the deep dive:
- A brief diagram of the egress path for sample data (if possible).
- One or two representative de-identified notes for the prompt examples (CSV or JSON).

I'll prepare a short integration checklist and a readiness playbook to share after the kickoff. Monica — if you have the success criteria template, can you attach it to the mutual action plan?

Looking forward — Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
